verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਪੰਖ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਮੋਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਓਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nain bain pa(n)kh su(n)dhar saraba(n)g mor taa ke pag or dhekh dhokh na beechaareeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a peacock's eyes, call, feathers and all other limbs are beautiful, one should not condemn him for his ugly feet. (see the merits alone).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਦਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ॥ ਕੰਟਕਿ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਨ ਅਉਗਨ ਉਰਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)dhal suga(n)dh at komal kamal jaise|| ka(n)Tak bilok na aaugan uradhaareeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as Sandalwood is very fragrant and lotus flower very delicate, one should not bring to mind their demerit of the fact that a snake generally wraps itself around the sandalwood tree while a lotus flower has thorn on its stem.
